arguments.command:
cd /work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
rng = random.Random(42)
n=96
pairs=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n)]
rng.shuffle(pairs)
edges=[{"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":rng.randint(1,10000),"ack_us":rng.randint(1,10000),"label":rng.choice(["a","b","c","d","e"])} for (u,v) in pairs[:384]]
rounds=[]
for i in range(48):
    rounds.append({"launch_us":rng.randint(0,1000),"timeout_us":rng.randint(1,1000000),"host_delay_us":rng.randint(1,10000),
                   "drop_host_ack":rng.random()<0.2,
                   "drop_ping":rng.sample(range(len(edges)), 20),
                   "drop_ack":rng.sample(range(len(edges)), 20)})
doc={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[48]*n,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}
raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print("bytes", len(raw))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/work/submission/main.py"],input=raw,capture_output=True)
el=time.time()-t
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%el, "outbytes", len(p.stdout))
if p.returncode==0:
    o=json.loads(p.stdout)
    print("summary", o["summary"])
    print("metrics", {k:v for k,v in o["metrics"].items() if k!="cache_peak"})
EOF
